name: @glot/live-stream
description: Translate a text stream while it streams: wrap an LLM answer (ReadableStream / async iterator) and get it back in another language.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts src/dom.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outdir=dist && esbuild src/dom.global.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=../../web/public/widget/glot-live.js && (echo '// GENERATED by packages/live-stream (npm run build) from src/index.ts: edit it there.' && cat src/index.ts) > ../../web/lib/live-stream.ts && tsc && sed -i.bak 's/\.ts";$/.js";/' dist/*.d.ts && rm dist/*.bak
